name: item.fist.name
editNote: Accepted: the book's Unarmed Attacks table (p.277) prints Fist as a bare stat line with no prose, like every unarmed attack entry, so 'no-description' matches the book exactly. Critical Specialization Effects for its brawling group are printed once under the weapon groups rules rather than repeated per weapon, the same recorded omission already accepted for other weapons in this import.
